covered_report_window.description: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the U.S. market close on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, plus companies reporting before the U.S. market open on Wednesday, November 4, 2026.

market_context_summary: The Nasdaq remained volatile after a sharp prior selloff; AI-capex expectations were elevated, oil remained high amid the Iran conflict, and U.S. midterm-election results plus Wednesday ADP/ISM-services data added macro event risk.

methodology.disparity_formula: Rounded value of 1.5 times the mean absolute deviation of the three direction scores plus the mean absolute deviation of the three reversal-risk values.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: The Q1 revenue and gross-margin preannouncement was exceptional, but the reaction now hinges on FY27 guidance and cash conversion rather than the known beat.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Preliminary Q1 revenue is $18.5B-$19.5B and gross margin 12.0%-12.5%, both well above prior guidance; consensus EPS is about $1.20.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: FY27 revenue rises above $72B and management shows durable double-digit margins plus better cash conversion.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: The known beat is sold because forward margin, working capital, or customer concentration disappoints.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 14.2%; the preannouncement and a 3.6% intraday rise raise event-volatility unwind risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The Oct. 20 preliminary update reset the bar sharply upward; the remaining revision question is FY27 durability.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Gross bookings and Q4 bookings guide
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: AV strategy, gas costs, softer Q4 bar
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A de-risked share price and sustained 20%+ bookings growth favor relief upside if Q4 bookings and AV commentary are steady.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Street gross bookings are about $59.8B within the $58.25B-$60.25B guide; EPS estimates cluster near $0.86-$0.91.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Bookings clear the midpoint, margins compound, and AV partnerships reduce disruption fears.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Q4 bookings guide is soft or AV/gas-cost commentary reinforces structural concerns.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 7.8%-8.1%, well above recent realized earnings reactions; shares are down about 19% YTD.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: BofA expects near-consensus bookings and slightly above-consensus EPS but trimmed its Q4 bookings view.
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Low-bar relief test and key-metric-first booking test applied.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Room nights and Q4 travel guide
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Resilient travel demand, a compressed multiple, and a reset share price favor upside if room nights exceed the 3%-5% guide.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Q3 guidance calls for 3%-5% room-night growth, 4%-6% gross-bookings growth, and 4%-6% adjusted EBITDA growth.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Room nights beat 5%, direct mix improves, and Q4 demand remains resilient.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Travel slows or management validates fears that AI changes customer acquisition economics.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 7%, slightly above the roughly 6.6% historical average; shares entered the day weak.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Published expectations remain near company guidance; valuation has compressed as AI-disintermediation concerns rose.
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Expectation-bar and decisive room-night metric applied.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Raised guidance and Aetna recovery support modest upside if the medical-benefit ratio confirms durable cost control.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is roughly $1.62-$1.66 EPS and $105B revenue; estimates were broadly unchanged into the print.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Aetna margins recover faster, Medicare stays favorable, and full-year guidance rises again.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Elevated utilization or pharmacy reimbursement pressure overwhelms the earnings beat.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 7.2%, above CVS's long-run average; the stock has risen roughly 19% over six months.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q2 guidance was raised, but the Street has kept Q3 estimates mostly stable while awaiting utilization evidence.
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Key-metric-first MBR test and priced-in recovery check applied.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Large AI-customer usage and Q4 growth
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: The premium valuation leaves downside risk if the large AI customer's usage reduction keeps Q4 growth below the prior 36% pace.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Q2 revenue grew 36%, but FY26 guidance of $4.45B-$4.47B embeds deceleration after a major customer reduced usage.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: The large customer stabilizes, non-AI growth stays high-20s, and Q4 guidance reaccelerates.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Concentration pressure persists and a sub-30% guide triggers multiple compression.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 14.6%; recent analyst enthusiasm and a 1.8% intraday gain raise the reaction bar.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: A recent Bernstein upgrade and price-target increase reflect stronger AI token-consumption expectations.
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Premium-software forward-guide weight raised; expectation penalty applied.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A low formal guidance bar supports relief upside, but pricing and competitive uncertainty keep the edge narrow.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Several banks reportedly see room for guidance above the current adjusted sales-growth range of -6% to 0%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Wegovy demand supports a guide raise and management contains pricing concerns.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: U.S. pricing, share loss, or a cautious 2027 setup offsets any near-term beat.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 7.3%, above the roughly 5.2% long-run average; shares remain heavily de-rated.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Bank previews skew toward a modest guide raise, lifting the whisper bar above published guidance.
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Low-bar relief test applied; evidence gap kept confidence Low.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Scorpio ramp and Q4 revenue guide
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: AI demand delivers another large beat
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Scorpio momentum is exceptional, but a roughly 119x P/E and strong pre-earnings rally require another outsized beat-and-raise.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Q3 revenue guidance is $540M-$560M after Q2 revenue rose 104% year over year; consensus EPS is near $1.19.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Scorpio becomes the largest product family early and Q4 guidance materially clears the buy-side bar.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Growth or gross margin normalizes, exposing the valuation and customer concentration.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 14.2%; shares were up roughly 4.5% intraday before the report.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Prior guidance and product-ramp commentary drove estimates higher, making the true bar likely above consensus.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Weak U.S. traffic execution and consumer pressure tilt down unless value offers produce a clear comparable-sales rebound.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is about $3.38; Q2 U.S. same-store sales rose only 0.8% and revenue slightly missed expectations.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Digital offers restore traffic and U.S. comparable sales reaccelerate without margin damage.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Low-income traffic stays weak and promotions pressure franchisee economics.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 3.9%, slightly above the historical average; defensive ownership can limit downside.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The Q2 execution miss leaves a measurable recovery bar, but estimate changes were not reliably available.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Broad 38% growth supports upside, but the premium multiple and AI crowding demand a strong 2027 outlook.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Q2 revenue topped $3B, up 37.7%, with EPS up 39.7%; consensus Q3 EPS is near $1.08.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: AI networking growth stays broad and management raises its longer-term growth framework.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Customer concentration or slower 2027 growth makes a good quarter insufficient.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 10.5%; shares were up roughly 2.6% intraday and trade near 52x earnings.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Fundamentals support positive revisions, but the valuation suggests a high embedded growth bar.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: AI and server momentum are powerful, but a 5% pre-report rally and extreme valuation leave little edge unless Q4 guidance materially exceeds whispers.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Q3 guidance is about $13B revenue with strong data-center growth; consensus EPS is roughly $1.68-$1.97 depending on source.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: MI350/MI450 demand and server share gains drive a materially above-consensus Q4 guide.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A routine beat, weaker mix, or cautious capacity commentary triggers multiple compression.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 8.3%-8.9%; shares were up about 5% intraday and trade near 126x trailing earnings.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Analyst previews are constructive and at least one raised 2026 revenue/EPS estimates, increasing the whisper bar.
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Premium-growth priced-in penalty and forward-look override applied.

research_allocation_view.qualification_reason: Absolute consensus score above 30, reversal risk at or below 40, sufficient evidence, and low pass disparity.
